title: Local account profiles
description: Each profile keeps a separate roster, base layout, rotation, schedule results, manual schedule and Mower setup. Switching saves your current data and reloads the workbench.
localNotice: Stored only in this browser. Clearing browser data removes profiles; export JSON backups. Website sign-in and Skland authorization remain separate. Profiles are not automatically uploaded to the cloud.
name: Profile name
namePlaceholder: For example: Main account, Alt account
emptyHint: Does not copy the roster, results or manual schedule.
importHint: Imports add new profiles without overwriting existing ones. Select an imported profile from the list to switch.
imported: Added {count} profiles. Select one from the list to switch.
busy: Wait for scheduling or synchronization to finish before switching.
errorName: Enter a name of up to 40 characters.
errorFile: Invalid file or contents. Import profile JSON exported by this site.
errorLimit: A maximum of 20 profiles can be saved.
errorSize: The file exceeds 8 MB. Import smaller files separately.
errorStorage: Unable to save local profiles. Browser storage may be full. Export JSON backups first.
errorChanged: Another tab switched the active profile. Reload before continuing.
